# Fabric8Labs

> Fabric8Labs is a San Diego, California advanced-manufacturing company that invented
> Electrochemical Additive Manufacturing (ECAM) — a room-temperature metal 3D printing process that
> electroplates copper out of a water-based metal-salt solution, pixel by pixel, through a patented
> microelectrode array printhead. It operates as a production foundry for data-center liquid
> cooling, AI/HPC thermal management, RF and wireless, aerospace, power electronics and photonics.

**This file was generated by API Evangelist, not published by Fabric8Labs.**
https://www.fabric8labs.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 404. It is assembled from the company's public
website and from the machine-readable surface its own host serves. Treat every link below as
third-party observation, not vendor documentation.

## What Fabric8Labs does and does not offer developers

Fabric8Labs sells manufactured metal components. It runs **no developer program, no API product, no
developer portal, no documentation host and no SDKs**. `api.fabric8labs.com`,
`docs.fabric8labs.com` and `developer.fabric8labs.com` do not resolve in DNS. If you are looking
for a Fabric8Labs product API to integrate with, there is not one — the correct route is the
contact form. The machine-readable surface described below is the WordPress installation behind the
company's marketing site, and it is useful for reading company content, nothing more.

## Public API surface (WordPress REST, wp/v2)

Anonymous, read-only, no credential required. Base: `https://www.fabric8labs.com/wp-json`

- [Route index](https://www.fabric8labs.com/wp-json): The full WordPress REST route index, 367 routes across 22 namespaces. Most are plugin admin routes that return 401.
- [Posts](https://www.fabric8labs.com/wp-json/wp/v2/posts): 13 newsroom and technical-showcase posts.
- [Pages](https://www.fabric8labs.com/wp-json/wp/v2/pages): 27 site pages.
- [Media](https://www.fabric8labs.com/wp-json/wp/v2/media): 276 attachments.
- [Team](https://www.fabric8labs.com/wp-json/wp/v2/team): A 3-record leadership directory, a custom post type registered by the site theme.
- [Categories](https://www.fabric8labs.com/wp-json/wp/v2/categories): 6 content categories.
- [Search](https://www.fabric8labs.com/wp-json/wp/v2/search): Unified search across public post types.
- [Types](https://www.fabric8labs.com/wp-json/wp/v2/types), [Taxonomies](https://www.fabric8labs.com/wp-json/wp/v2/taxonomies), [Statuses](https://www.fabric8labs.com/wp-json/wp/v2/statuses): Schema discovery.

Pagination is `page` + `per_page` (max 100), with `X-WP-Total` and `X-WP-TotalPages` response
headers and RFC 5988 `Link` rel="next"/"prev". Errors come back as
`{"code","message","data":{"status"}}`, not RFC 9457 problem+json.

## Agent surface

- [MCP server](https://www.fabric8labs.com/wp-json/mcp/mcp-oauth-server): Live WordPress MCP Adapter endpoint. **Authentication-gated** — anonymous `tools/list` returns 401 `mcp_unauthorized`. Tool names and input schemas are not publicly readable.
- [OAuth authorization server metadata](https://www.fabric8labs.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server): RFC 8414. Authorization code + PKCE S256, one scope: `mcp`.
- [OAuth protected resource metadata](https://www.fabric8labs.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): RFC 9728.
- No A2A agent card, no `/.well-known/security.txt`, no `api-catalog`, no `ai-plugin.json`.

## API Evangelist artifacts for this company

Derived from the surface above. Repo: https://github.com/api-evangelist/fabric8labs

- `openapi/` — seven OpenAPI 3.1.0 documents, 19 operations, built from the live route index and per-route OPTIONS schemas.
- `mcp/` — MCP server manifest and tool crosswalk (crosswalk unmeasurable, server is gated).
- `authentication/`, `scopes/` — the anonymous read surface and the gated OAuth/MCP surface.
- `well-known/` — the two real well-known documents plus every 404 recorded as an absence.
- `conventions/`, `errors/`, `data-model/`, `examples/`, `lifecycle/`, `conformance/` — derived runtime semantics.
- `skills/` — agent skills grounded in real operationIds.
- `security/` — TLS/DNS posture probe.

## Not present

No SDKs or first-party packages on any registry. No CLI. No embedded components. No sandbox or test
credentials. No pricing or plans page. No published rate limits. No dated changelog. No status page.
No deprecation policy. No AsyncAPI, webhooks or event surface. No gRPC. No Postman collection. No
security.txt, bug bounty or trust center. Each of these is a measured absence recorded in the repo,
not an unchecked gap.
